from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,os,signal
repo=Path('/Users/steventran/jobpipe');base='b8a787b5b6c9df5bda03db4b5c9f3da67d80317a'
url='https://jobs.lever.co/ethena/f85bcfd1-8d2c-4cf5-a6ab-1c8ddab14c65/apply'
def git(*a):return subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=repo,check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout.strip()
if git('rev-parse','HEAD')!=base:raise SystemExit('AUTHORITY_CHANGED')
p=subprocess.Popen([str(repo/'.venv/bin/python'),'tools/live_ats_inspect.py',url],cwd=repo,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
try:o,e=p.communicate(timeout=75)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);raise SystemExit('TIMEOUT')
print('INSPECT_EXIT',p.returncode,flush=True)
if p.returncode:
 print('INSPECT_ERROR_TAIL',e[-700:],flush=True);raise SystemExit('INSPECTION_FAILED')
x=json.loads(o)
assert x['url_host']=='jobs.lever.co' and x['diagnostic_only'] is True,x
assert x['auth']=='not_attempted' and x['submission']=='not_attempted' and x['live_review']=='not_verified',x
assert isinstance(x['http_status'],int) and isinstance(x['form_count'],int) and isinstance(x['input_count'],int),x
assert x['application_form_detected']==bool(x['form_count'] and x['input_count']),x
print('LIVE_PUBLIC_LEVER_APPLY_PAGE',json.dumps(x,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
assert git('rev-parse','HEAD')==base
print('HEAD_UNCHANGED=True; SUBMISSIONS=NOT_ATTEMPTED',flush=True)
